claims.claim_text: The fixture evidence directly supports preservation of a spectral line measurement during restoration.
A second fixture paper reports detector-noise removal with absorption-line preservation, but the fixture does not establish generalization.
No fixture evidence supports a claim that the method is universally best.

rendered_review.text: The synthetic evidence reports line preservation during restoration [claim_001]. A second paper is directionally consistent, while generalization remains unverified [claim_002]. The fixture does not support universal superiority [claim_003].
